title: Theme
description: A theme: design tokens (fonts, colors, borders, spacing, textures, masks, page) and optional per-component overrides. Themes are data; the theme engine compiles them to CSS custom properties.

tokens.description: The theme's default value for every token.

components.description: Per-component overrides, keyed by component name (such as readaloud). A component's value wins over the book's and the theme's defaults.

TokenMap.description: Token name to CSS value. A name is a category (font, color, border, spacing, texture, mask or page) followed by dotted lowercase parts, such as font.body or color.accent. It becomes the custom property --font-body.
